notes.title: Announcement of the Time Attack Campaign Sale
notes.content:
[h2]Announcement of the Time Attack Campaign Sale[/h2]

Since its release, Death Forest Abyss has been played extensively by YouTubers and has achieved over 3 million total video views within its first month.

To enhance your experience with Death Forest Abyss, we have added a new feature that displays your completion time. To celebrate this update, we are launching a Time Attack Campaign where players can compete to complete the game as quickly as possible!

In conjunction with this event, we are pleased to announce a 10% OFF sale for those who are interested in Death Forest Abyss but have yet to play it.

[h2]Updated Sale Period[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Before Change[/b]: 2024/12/6 6:00–12/19 6:00 (JST)
[*] [b]After Change[/b]: 2024/12/6 23:00–12/19 23:00 (JST)
[/list]
Please note: The release time has been updated due to an adjustment by the campaign organizers. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this change.

We hope you take this opportunity to try the game!
Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Ver1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Ver1.0.1 Update

・Game optimization has been implemented.
・The effects for the Stranger have been adjusted.
・A bug with the Hide Hand has been fixed.
・A feature to display the completion time after clearing has been added.
・Some changes have been made to the lighting specifications.
・Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Ver1.0.1 Update Announcement
notes.content:
